reproduction.description: Compare a real average-linkage dendrogram with k-means centroids and planted-program recovery.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
48 generated profiles at 12 times with three groups replace yeastData310 and 16 clusters.
Average linkage and k-means are implemented; single/complete-link comparisons and a toolbox clustergram UI are omitted.
K-means uses row-standardized data for shape comparison rather than the original raw-data Euclidean call.
